spiritgiven.comments: Thanks for the game! We appreciated that you checked in with us about the level of physicality during the game. Best of luck to you this tournament!

Thanks for the game! 

In general, we appreciated the communication between our two teams which are relatively new to WUC, especially the post-game spirit captain debrief. Happy to see we are on the same page to keep trying to adjust and decrease physicality. It seems like both teams felt like physicality did not decrease despite communication and we can both work on that.

We also appreciated the fair mindedness in a few calls, but also felt that some calls took too long to resolve.

Thanks so much for the game! We thought that it was a spirited game and calls were discussed quickly and fairly.

Thank you for being fair minded and understanding about our accidental physicality. Best of luck to you!

Thanks so much for the game and the pre-spirit circle (:

We appreciated the communication between our teams and thanks for adjusting during the game. All the best to you at WUC!

Thank you for the game! What a windy one!

For fair mindedness, we thought that sometimes your sideline would help bring the disc back but not to where it went out.

For rules knowledge and use, your player was very sure and forceful in saying that they are allowed to kick the cone away but that wasn't the case. We appreciated that it didn't happen again after our communication (: best of luck to you!

Thank you for the game!

Both of our teams showed that they really wanted the disc and we feel like it was physical on both sides. After adjusting, we feel it was less physical as the game continued.

For fair mindedness, we did not think it was fair when you mentioned that your team will make more calls if our team keeps making calls.

Thank you for adjusting after we mentioned the rule about where sideline teammates can bring the disc closer to the field.

Best of luck!

Thank you for the game! Barely any calls and very spirited game.

Positive attitude: thank you for being encouraging after each point! All the best for the rest of the tourney!

Thank you for the game!

We think the rules knowledge and use is not quite there yet with movement during calls and being unclear about travel being a stoppage of play or not.

We thought the calls were fair and you gave us the benefit of the doubt; thank you!

We thought your attitude was great towards us during the calls and conducting yourselves during the game.

All the best to your team!

Thank you for the game!

We felt the rules knowledge and use was not quite there yet with the constant double teaming.

For fouls and body contact we felt there was contact throughout the game and one dangerous play to our player who was stationary.

Fair-minded to always check if players are ready before tapping the disc in.

We appreciated the positive attitude between each point and throughout the calls. Thank you for adjusting offsides during the game! All the best!

spiritreceived.comments:
- Good communications between both teams in terms on the several check-ins to ensure the calls are not affecting the teams' spirit
- Both teams agreed to minimize body contacts and agreed on the physicality level however we feel there's still not much improvement received from the other team. We've highlighted this to them and the feedback was well noted for the upcoming games.

Very willing to listen to us, and often checked in after points whether the physicality was of an acceptable level. Also very willing to make calls unfavourable to their side, after taking in different perspectives.

Great game, obviously the wind didn’t allow us to play the way we wanted, however the game was good spirited. Communication and receptiveness was very good. They maintained their good attitude throughout the entire game despite the score.
Positivity and calmness throughout the game, even though it was a tight game

Well spirited game, for attitude and self control it was a high 2 because they maintained positivity throughout the game. Some of the double teams were called incorrectly especially when their handlers moved into the space. But great game!!
